top_strength: Jevic excellently gathered complex logistics details — donation location, piano handling, unwrap/rewrap requirements, full 10x20 unit inventory — and clearly confirmed crew size (three movers) and next steps with the customer's full participation.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire consultative framework (no concerns question, no promises, no pricing context, no final concerns check) and jumped straight to inventory-gathering and a one-way estimate delivery; the 15-minute quote call structure exists to build trust and handle objections before they derail the booking — retrain on step 2 (two-concerns question before probing) and step 7 (explicit ask for the business with rate lock mentioned first).
